Penguins measured per island (after cleaning, 52 unique penguins): Biscoe 28, Dream 16, Torgersen 8.

Data problems found and fixed:
- Island label variants: "Dream " (trailing space), "Bisco", and "Torgerson" were merged into the allowed labels Dream, Biscoe, Torgersen (3 rows affected).
- 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 6 and 16) were removed so each penguin is counted once.

Caveats: body_mass_g has 3 values stored as text (e.g. "3,300") and sex has a "FEMALE" case variant, but neither affects this count question, so they were left unchanged.
